_comment: Survey-sourced DOWNLOAD CANDIDATES (WS-D, 2026-07-07). This is NOT the frozen datasets.lock.json — it lists B-grade (publicly obtainable) datasets that are NOT yet on disk, surfaced by the post-2025.01 multimodal-knowledge survey and queued for owner review + fetch. Each entry fills an empty coverage cell or enables comparison with an admissible (A/B) baseline. Exact hf/git ids + pinned revisions must be RESOLVED at fetch time (source_hint is best-effort; 'source_resolve' entries need confirmation). To download after review: add confirmed entries to datasets.lock.json (status MISSING) or fetch directly. See wiki/survey/2026-07-07-multimodal-knowledge-systems-alignment.md. RESOLVED (web-verified 2026-07-07): authoritative download sources now live in scripts/data/fetch-candidates.sh CANDS[]. Direct HF: audiocaps-qa=AudioLLMs/audiocaps_qa_test, audio2tool=RVtech/Audio2Tool, auditorybench-plusplus=HJOK/AuditoryBenchpp, squtr=SLLMCommunity/SQuTR (21GB). Special: full-duplex-bench-v3=git DanielLin94144/Full-Duplex-Bench (+Google Drive), mlc-slm=gated nexdata.ai/competition/mlc-slm (register+DUA). AudioCaps-QA is borrowed from AudioBench, NOT a VAT-KG release (VAT-KG artifacts are private/404).
current_semantics: Historical candidate catalog, not a claim that every entry is absent from disk. Current local state is authoritative only in the layered inventory and Stage-1C acquisition matrix.

candidates.name: slue-sqa-5
candidates.fills_gap: spoken-QA breadth beyond heysquad/spoken-squad; audio-native retrieval
candidates.source_hint: SLUE Phase-2 (asappresearch/slue-toolkit; HF 'asapp/slue-phase-2' — confirm subset SQA-5)
candidates.note: WavRAG's second QA eval set; extends the only local-mapped audio-native RAG comparison.

candidates.name: audiocaps-qa
candidates.fills_gap: {audio-native ∩ training-free} comparison — currently EMPTY on local sets
candidates.admissible_baseline: VAT-KG (2506.21556, B, training-free); M3KG-RAG (2512.20136, B, training-free)
candidates.source_hint: derived from AudioCaps (HF 'd0rj/audiocaps' / cvssp); VAT-KG QA split may need paper release
candidates.note: The two training-free audio-native MMKG-RAG baselines both eval here; closest analogue to our thesis.

candidates.name: audio2tool
candidates.fills_gap: agentic audio-native tool-use (Qwen3-Omni-30B baseline exists — our own model)
candidates.note: Locally complete at the pinned HF revision (71,441 content files / 10,410,773,494 bytes); not promoted into FROZEN_BASELINE.

candidates.name: auditorybench-plusplus
candidates.note: Directly probes non-lexical auditory commonsense — the acoustic-knowledge cell nearest crema-d/meld.

candidates.name: esc-50
candidates.note: Canonical 50-class environmental sound set; iKnow-audio's AKG reranks CLAP on this family.

candidates.name: fsd50k
candidates.note: 51k clips, 200 classes; larger acoustic-knowledge key source for the audio-native cell.

candidates.name: squtr
candidates.fills_gap: retrieval robustness testbed (noise/SNR) for the audio-key retriever itself
candidates.source_hint: arXiv 2602.12783 (37,317 queries over 6 public EN/ZH sets; source_resolve)
candidates.note: Directly stress-tests our KEY=audio retriever under acoustic noise — a diagnostic for kb_index/kb_embed.
